To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the structural transformation of selenido stannate from 1D chain to 0D dimentions and 2D layered structures was achieved through the amine-induced assembly process, and the resulting materials exhibit photocurrent responses, indicating their potential applications as semiconducting materials.

we have successfully synthesized a series of novel selenidostanante compounds with different dimensionalities, and their structural transformation from 1D, 0D, to 2D can be realized via a stepwise assembly strategy.

we have demonstrated a stepwise amines-induced structure transformation from 1D chain to 0D dianion, and to 2D layer, and the photocurrent properties of these selenidosteannates with different dimensionalities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the structural evolution of the amine-induced selenidostannaes and their photocurrent response.
the stepwise structural transformation of 1D selenidostannaes into 0D and then 2D via an amine-templating approach.
the stepwise transformation of selenido-tin compounds from 1D chains to 0D dimers and 2D layers, which is induced by amine-templating.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the amine-induced structural transformations of these selenidosteannates can be achieved by a stepwise assembly strategy, which provides a new strategy to prepare selenidostanante-based materials with different dimensionalities and potential applications in photoelectric devices.
the structural dimensionalities of the selenidostannaes can be tuned by amine templates via stepwise cleavage and reformation of the metal-ligand bonds.
the structural dimensionality of selenidotinates is highly dependent on the amine templates, which can induce the transformation from 1D chain, 0D dianionic [Sn2Se62-] to 2D layered structures.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a stepwise ammine-templated assembly can be used to control the structural transformation of selenido-tinates from 1 to 2D and 0D.
a series of amine-induced structural transformation from 1D chains to 0D dimers and 2D layers was realized by the cleavage and reformation of the Se-Fe and Sn-Se bonds.

the structural dimensionalities of selenidometallate-based compounds are tunable by introducing amine templates into the assembly process, which can be attributed to the different coordination modes of amine ligands and the amine-induced structural transformation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the structure transformation of selenostannates can be controlled by a stepwise ammine template strategy.
the structural transformation of selenides can be controlled by the choice of the amine template, which is of great value for the design of functional selenide materials.
the structural dimensionalities of selenidotinates can be readily modulated by introducing a variety of amines as templates.
